progress_events.note: Начат по прямому назначению. Использую существующие ownership::claim + cli::ownership::execute; owned write path — новый application/workspace.rs и tests. Проверю общий file authority, wrong-owner/ACL reject и reopen; shared export оставлю Терe.

changes.result: Source slice committed 74d4cf6c: workspace MCP adapter delegates claim/release to canonical ownership file authority, enforces verified principal and exact write ACL, creates stable UUID claim IDs and reports errors/statuses. `cargo test application::workspace::tests --lib` PASS 2/2: shared temp authority race against offline CLI had exactly one winner; wrong principal release rejected; missing ACL denied; reopened authority readback succeeded. User explicitly authorized the single `pub mod workspace;` export hunk, included. Not proven: resource.claim via NativeServer MCP wire consumer; commit published to current main.
